verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a prefunded model through balance accounts, either a single pool of funds or a balance per card, linked to cards via balanceAccountId. Relayed authorisation lets your own system approve or decline each authorization in real time within 2000 ms, with configurable fallback. However, relayed authorisation is approval-only; nothing shows your system funding each authorization just-in-time, and no cash-flow tradeoff guidance is given. Missing for 10: a documented just-in-time funding mode where funds move per authorization, a documented choice between funding models, cash-flow tradeoff documentation, and independent corroboration.
